authorizes: nothing: no test generation, no student run, no GPU

sets.comparator_selection: new family-disjoint set, used ONLY to name the strongest single deployable teacher
sets.test: new family-disjoint set, sealed until the student, comparator and this protocol are frozen
forbidden_sources: any P1-12/P1-13/P1-14 TRAIN or counterfactual scenario
any development family used for model selection

design.matching: student and all five teachers run on the identical scenario, seed and simulator code

comparator_rule.data: comparator_selection set totals only; never test outcomes
comparator_rule.deployable: a retained registry identity running alone within the latency budget

oracle: per-scenario best teacher in hindsight; reported separately; never a deployable baseline

primary.contrast: student minus comparator, paired per scenario, averaged per family
primary.test: one-sided family bootstrap, upper bound of the mean family difference < 0

guards.severe_regression: student primary exceeds comparator primary by >= max(3, 0.10 * N) in a scenario

latency_ms.note: set from the measured GPU preflight and the deployment deadline (HLD A7) before freeze; null blocks freeze

secondary.vs_each_teacher: same primary test against every teacher, Holm adjustment over 5 at one-sided 0.025

not_success: beating the oracle is not required
